facts.fact: Nick 到来后她从 Alexander 的意识中流失，如水冲进水槽。
facts.anchor: I drained from his mind like water down the sink.

facts.fact: 他偶尔瞥见她会吓一跳，像完全忘了她的存在。
facts.anchor: Sometimes he would catch sight of me and startle, as though he had entirely forgotten my existence.

facts.fact: Alexander 从未在宅中作祟，但他以记忆的方式永久纠缠她。
facts.anchor: he very much haunts me, but only his memory

facts.fact: Nick 擅自进她房间时，她忽然看见未来：她独自坐在那两间小房间里年复一年。
facts.anchor: I had a vision, suddenly, of years stretching before me as I sat alone in those two little rooms

facts.fact: Nick 临走丢下一句：你丈夫派我寻找你的父亲。
facts.anchor: your husband has tasked me with finding your father

facts.fact: 他对口袋里的纸片与黑羽毛露出从未给过她的温柔神情。
facts.anchor: Alexander smiled down at these treasures with greater tenderness than he had ever shown me.

facts.fact: 她觉得自己已是房子腐烂的一部分，吸入从墙壁渗出的邪恶。
facts.anchor: I was part of its rottenness, breathing in the evilness pouring out from the walls

facts.fact: 车灯照亮瞬间她看见司机不是 Alexander，车随即打滑冲进冰封的湖。
facts.anchor: I saw that the driver was not Alexander.
